notes: 31 direct PLUS observations:26 new key-replay cases and five exact rechecks of old frames.Identical rechecks are not counted twice.
The pending operation determines Stack Goto;an appended+13 control proves the cursor is not inferred from the final entered position.
MathI flat-input caret visibility reserves the full glyph immediately to its right,and pans in8-pixel steps.Ordinary long input and both error-return continuations use the same geometry.
Value-stack and operator-stack overflow are separately measured;delete/correct/EXE recovers to result1.
Source-position mapping is restricted to flat numeric Calculate MathI;structured,function-expanded and other-app mappings retain their previous handling.

30-sign control locates the first overflowing operator inside a scanned sign batch.Insertion plus seven RIGHT moves disambiguates repeated minus glyphs;the diagnostic insertion then gives the native Syntax ERROR,not a numerical result.
